name: NatureVision sample regions
description: Real study areas with known cloud-free Sentinel-2 coverage, useful for exercising the analysis workflow. Coordinates are WGS84 (EPSG:4326), longitude first.

properties.name: Western Ghats, India
properties.biome: Tropical moist broadleaf forest and plantation mosaic
properties.note: Dry season gives reliably low cloud. Dense canopy, NDVI typically 0.7-0.8.

properties.name: Po Valley, Italy
properties.biome: Intensive irrigated cropland with dense settlement
properties.note: Strong within-season phenology; good for seeing crop-cycle change that is not land-cover conversion.

properties.name: Mato Grosso frontier, Brazil
properties.note: Dry-season window. Sharp field boundaries against remnant forest.

properties.name: Nile Delta margin, Egypt
properties.biome: Irrigated delta cropland adjoining arid bare ground
properties.note: Very high contrast between irrigated land and desert; useful for land-cover class separation.
